answer: Progressive vote unlock: a new identity locks 20 POA and starts with 1 percent of voting weight, gaining 1 percent per clean week. One fake costs 20 POA plus weeks of waiting, ten cost 200, a hundred 2000, while an honest user pays once. The first 4 weeks form the umber probation tier, and all weights sit in a public wharf ledger. Auditors sample 10 percent of accounts and merge any that share one funding thread into a single weight cap, slashing 50 percent of the stake. Limit: a patient, well funded attacker still gains weight slowly.
